job: See activity over weeks, one cell per day, or an outcome per day.
purpose: A grid of day cells: weeks run in columns, Monday to Sunday in rows. Five steps run from a faint ink wash to the full accent, cut at the quartiles of the busy days so one spike does not flatten the rest. The strip variant shows one row of days with a tone each and a legend, for pass, slow or fail.
useWhen: Activity over weeks or months: requests, commits, runs per day.
Each day has an outcome, not an amount: use the strip with a legend.
A table cell needs the last 14 days at a glance: strip at data-size="sm".

avoidWhen.when: A value that changes by the hour or the minute.

states.name: active
states.how: data-active on the cell the crosshair or keyboard is on

states.name: empty
states.how: data-empty when a day has no data

states.name: none
states.how: data-none on a strip cell for a day with no outcome

states.name: entering
states.how: data-enter pending, run or done; columns draw in 14ms apart

variants.useWhen: One outcome per day: passed, slow, failed; no axis.
11px cells, or a strip for a table cell.
A heat grid in green, for healthy runs.

parts.role: A month label above the grid.
A weekday label beside the grid.

keyboard.does: Move by a week; in the strip, by a day.
Jump to the first or last day.
Fires fd:select, or follows the href of a strip day.
